'''Attendant''' was the lowest rank of the [[Intendant caste]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. Attendants were often just that, servants for other Yuuzhan Vong.<ref name="The New Jedi Order Sourcebook-">[[The New Jedi Order Sourcebook]]</ref>
